title: NFT-Othello
tagline: "In this world, to survive as a Token, one must surround the opponent, just like in Othello."
description:
1. Players can mint their preferred NFTs and place only two NFTs in the world each day.
2. NFTs that are sandwiched between other NFTs will no longer be your own. They will become those of the opponent.
3. I thought it would be interesting if the NFT could become the opponent's, but we couldn't implement that feature in time.
how_its_made: I created this while reading a MUD tutorial, watching Youtube videos, and looking at EmojiMonster. It was not as easy as the introduction suggested, but I really enjoyed using a framework that spans Web2 and Web3, just like RAILS, where once you define the structure of the data, you can immediately start reading and writing.
